page.overview:
Who is Foggy Fleece?

Foggy Fleece is an elderly female Pegasus pony with a very pale blue coat, white mane and tail, blue or orange eyes with dark blue pupils, and a cutie mark of a ball of purple yarn. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Foggy Fleece shares her body type, coat and blue iris and pupil colors, and cutie mark with Pearly Stitch, her body type and blue iris and pupil colors with S05E06 Unnamed Earth Mare #18, her body type and orange iris color with Granny Smith and S08E19 Unnamed Pegasus Stallion #1, and her body type with S07E10 Unnamed Earth Mare #4, "Lotus Petal", and elderly S04E20 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3.

In season four, Foggy Fleece appears in Leap of Faith with both of her wings in bandages. She attends Flim and Flam's demonstration of their miracle curative tonic. In Equestria Games, she appears very briefly as a Games spectator.
